sources.title: Grok 4 Fast launch, September 19, 2025
sources.evidence: Dated announcement explicitly makes both grok-4-fast-reasoning and grok-4-fast-non-reasoning generally available with 2M context. The modes share weights and differ through system-prompt steering; Fast is distinct from standard Grok 4. No parameter count or network type is disclosed.

sources.title: Grok 4 Fast Model Card
sources.evidence: Read the complete seven-page card, including training section and non-reasoning evaluations. Describes pretraining, supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning and evaluates tool use in both modes. It gives no total/active count or neural architecture specification.

sources.title: xAI Grok 4 Fast provider documentation
sources.evidence: Exact historical provider documentation lists xai.grok-4-fast-non-reasoning, text/image inputs, text output, 2,000,000 context and function calling. Non-reasoning skips thinking tokens. Oracle documents retirement August 15, 2026; these are historical serving specifications.

sources.title: Grok model retirement on May 15, 2026
sources.evidence: Official guide says the exact old non-reasoning slug redirects to Grok 4.3 with none reasoning effort after May 15, 2026. This records replacement behavior, not a change to the original Fast model’s size or context.

sources.title: Former exact model documentation URL
sources.evidence: The URL now redirects to the current model roster. It cannot establish original Fast specifications; the retained launch, card and provider documentation supply those instead.

sources.title: Enterprise Terms of Service, June 27, 2025
sources.evidence: Launch-period API terms grant limited non-transferable service access, reserve underlying technology ownership to xAI and restrict copying and reverse engineering. Supports descriptive proprietary classification. Web tool accessed the full page; a direct HTTP request returned 403.

sources.title: xAI public checkpoint inventory
sources.evidence: The returned public organization model inventory contains Grok 1 and Grok 2, not Grok 4 Fast. Used with the documented hosted distribution and service terms; older open-weight licenses are not transferred.

sources.title: Later Grok 4.1 Fast announcement and comparison
sources.evidence: Later article compares Grok 4.1 Fast with Grok 4 Fast, but gives no exact Fast total/active parameters or neural network layout. Its later model capabilities are not inherited.

sources.title: Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework, December 2025
sources.evidence: Read the later framework and exact Fast reference: it provides an approximate training-start date and general training practices, without parameter counts or network architecture for Fast.

sources.title: Grok 4.5 Model Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded and searched complete later card and comparison material for exact Grok 4 Fast disclosures. No exact Fast reference or count/layout table was found; later model specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 Model Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded and searched the full later card for exact Fast references. No exact Fast parameter or architecture disclosure was present.

sources.title: Grok 4.7 Model Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded and searched the full later card for exact Fast references. No exact Fast parameter or architecture disclosure was present. Exact-name training and interpretability searches also did not establish a primary network specification.

sources.title: xAI Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework, June 30, 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 original PDF fetched by the parent and independently read in full from the cache. The later framework describes safety, model lifecycle and weight security, with no Grok 4 Fast total or activated parameter count. Agent direct/web reopens returned 403/unavailable; cached original provenance records HTTP 200 at 15:57 UTC.

sources.title: Apriel-1.5-15B-Thinker: Mid-training is all you need, October 2025
sources.evidence: Freshly read original research report and visually inspected Figure 3, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index versus Total Parameters plot. Table 3 includes Grok 4 Fast benchmark results, but its parameter plot has no Grok point and the table provides no total or activated-parameter column. This later research comparison supplies no usable Fast count.

sources.title: OPENXRD: a comprehensive benchmark framework for LLM/MLLM XRD question answering, Table 1
sources.publisher: Ali Vosoughi et al., University of Rochester; Royal Society of Chemistry
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved indexed original Table 1 and its caption. The x-ai/grok-4-fast row has Params U; the caption defines U as undisclosed and uses total/active format for MoE entries. It therefore supplies no numeric total or active convention. The row does not specify a reasoning mode; no mode-specific inference is needed for this negative result. Direct HTML/PDF opens returned 403; this corroborative negative is based on indexed original text, not a fresh direct page fetch.

name.note: Readable name for the exact non-reasoning API variant; removes malformed provider/slug capitalization.

developer.note: Original developer identified by the launch and authored model card; later corporate branding does not alter release attribution.

family.note: Grok family, specifically the Fast model; not the standard Grok 4 release.

release_date.note: Exact API variant explicitly generally available on September 19. Replaces unsupported December 18 date. The announcement mentions earlier private arena testing but supplies no earlier public availability date for this API variant.

open_weights.note: Released through hosted API and consumer services under restricted rights; no exact public Fast checkpoint was offered by the checked developer sources. Grok 1/2 releases do not license Fast weights.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification under launch-period limited service rights and retained underlying technology ownership.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no published nominal total in the original launch/card, later xAI material or checked original research comparisons. The launch explicitly shares weights between Fast modes, but says Fast builds on learnings from Grok 4 and emphasizes smaller models; this is not an unchanged-base relationship that establishes a size. OPENXRD Table 1 labels Fast undisclosed; Apriel includes it only in performance comparisons. No count is inherited from the later Grok 4.3 endpoint replacement.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh separate searches and later original comparison checks found no supported activated-parameter count. Shared weights across Fast modes establish model identity, not the number of weights participating per token; fewer thinking tokens likewise do not establish active parameters. OPENXRD supplies no numeric total/active entry, and the Apriel comparison supplies no Fast size. No active count is inferred from total size, routing, pricing or a later replacement model.

architecture.note: Unified architecture describes shared weights for two response modes, not a disclosed Transformer/dense/MoE topology. Exact-name technical and interpretability searches and later cards supplied no primary network classification.

context_window.note: Original API contract is 2,000,000 tokens. The 1M context of the later Grok 4.3 redirect is not backdated to this release.

modalities.note: Exact provider documentation supports text and images in, text out. Remove unsupported audio/video inputs: media encountered through search and separate consumer voice features do not establish direct input modalities for this API variant.

reasoning.note: This mode skips extended thinking tokens, even though the underlying shared-weight model also supports a separate reasoning mode. False is a mode distinction, not a claim of inability to solve reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Non-reasoning tool-use evaluations and exact provider function-calling documentation support this capability.

description.value: Non-reasoning mode of Grok 4 Fast, accepting text and images with function calling and a two-million-token context window.
description.note: Describes documented original mode and capabilities without promoting speed or claiming extended reasoning.

patch.name: Grok 4 Fast (Non-Reasoning)
patch.description: Non-reasoning mode of Grok 4 Fast, accepting text and images with function calling and a two-million-token context window.
patch.notes: Released September 19, 2025. Reasoning and non-reasoning modes use the same Grok 4 Fast weights, steered by system prompts. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; the stated learnings from Grok 4 do not establish unchanged model size. Neural network topology remains undisclosed. Historical API specifications support text/image input and text output. xAI retired the original endpoint on May 15, 2026 and redirects this slug to Grok 4.3 with no reasoning; replacement specifications are not assigned to the original Fast release.

summary: Preserved the original fourteen-field audit and refreshed both parameter assessments on October 27. Total and active remain explicitly null/undisclosed after original launch/card, later xAI reports, original research comparisons and named-lineage checks. Shared Fast-mode weights are documented, but no numeric count or unchanged Grok 4 base lineage is established.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain parameters_b=null and active_parameters_b=null, both undisclosed, after separate fresh review.
fresh_search_queries: "Grok 4 Fast" ("base model" OR "fine-tuned" OR "distilled" OR "same weights")
parameter_reaudit.total_assessment: Reopened official release and complete original seven-page model card; no nominal total. Read December 2025 framework exact Fast reference and June 2026 framework; no count. Full-text searches of later 4.5/4.6/4.7 original cards found no Fast count. Apriel original Table 3 benchmarks Grok 4 Fast, but visually inspected Figure 3 omits it. OPENXRD original Table 1 explicitly marks its size U (undisclosed).
parameter_reaudit.active_assessment: Separate active/activated queries and comparison-table searches returned no usable numeric active count. Reduced thinking-token usage is an inference-compute measure, not an activated-weight count. Neither the original xAI documents nor the later original research comparisons establish an active convention.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_assessment: The September 19 launch explicitly identifies reasoning/non-reasoning as the same model weights. That would support count transfer between the two modes if either had a supported published count. Its relationship to standard Grok 4 is described only as learnings from that release, alongside smaller/faster language. The original card describes Fast pretraining and posttraining but names no unchanged base checkpoint. Thus Grok 1/2/4 figures and the later Grok 4.3 redirect are not inherited.
parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Bounded fresh searches found developer documents and original comparison leads, plus secondary directories leaving counts blank or repeating unattributed standard-Grok estimates. No unsupported estimate, price/latency-derived figure or unnamed teacher is adopted. OPENXRD is only corroborative negative evidence; its other rows include estimates and do not establish a Fast count.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: Original launch and Apriel HTML/figure fetched directly HTTP 200; original Fast model card and December framework reopened through the web reader. The parent freshly fetched original PDFs 25-29 and31 on October 27 (HTTP 200), which were independently read/searched here. Agent direct/web June-framework reopen was blocked. RSC HTML and PDF direct reopens returned 403; the full indexed original Table 1 and caption were freshly retrieved through search. The audit does not claim those blocked direct reopens succeeded.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: No supported nominal total, separately reported active size or named unchanged sized base is established for original Grok 4 Fast. Nulls reflect the evidence reviewed, not an assertion that the model has no parameters.
